column1: # Wave partition table (16 MB flash). Two app slots for over-the-air updates.
# The NVS partition keeps the offset and size of the single-app table that
# the encrypted AI keys and the radio calibration survive the change. otadata
# sits where the old app began; its checksums reject the old app's bytes and
# the bootloader starts ota_0. Moving to this table needs one USB flash.
